sections.heading: Introduction and contact directory
sections.body: Observatory roof dry inspection is a fictional activity. This overview names the activity but does not identify an authorizer or time allowance. Contact the service desk to locate the controlling sections.

sections.heading: Authorization and time allowance
sections.body: For observatory roof dry inspection, the observatory steward must approve the work. The authorized work window is two hours. This rule applies only to this activity and operating condition.

sections.heading: Documents to supply
sections.body: A request for observatory roof dry inspection must include inspection diagram and roof register. These two attachments are required before the activity begins.

sections.heading: Informational routing
sections.body: Observatory roof dry inspection follows a documented process. Questions about approval, duration and paperwork are routed to the policy. This routing notice supplies no actual approval role, time limit or attachment names.
